summary: Iteration 110 - Payroll Worksheet Architecture Rewrite Testing. All 6 fixes verified: (1) No refetch loop - 0 API requests during 6s idle, (2) Notes alone don't block save - code correctly excludes notes from hasShiftContent check, (3) Legacy entries only saved when changed - 0 PUT requests to legacy-manual-entries on unchanged save, (4) Section-by-section error reporting - each section wrapped in try/catch, (5) Adjustment sign change works - tested via UI, (6) Adding end time to existing shift works - tested via UI with successful save.

issues: Notes column not visible in week table UI - notes field exists in data model but not editable via table (may be intentional design)

critical_code_review_comments: FIX 1: doLoadWorksheet is now a regular function (not useCallback), useEffect depends only on [selectedEmployeeId, startDate, endDate, canViewPayroll] - eliminates refetch loop
FIX 2: hasShiftContent (line 174) correctly checks only time fields: [row.startTime, row.lunchStart, row.lunchEnd, row.endTime].some(Boolean)
FIX 3: baselineLegacyRef tracks original legacy entries, only changed entries get PUT (line 426-439)
FIX 4: handleSaveWorksheet has section-by-section try/catch for employee, shifts, adjustments, legacy, signoff
FIX 5: Adjustment save logic handles sign changes via inferTransactionType function
FIX 6: validateRows allows active shifts (working/on_break) with start time but no end time
Minor: ESLint warning about missing validateRows dependency in useCallback (line 493) - can be suppressed
seed_data_creation: None - used existing QA Test Employee - Iteration 104 (id: 18eed187-1a90-4bf8-b233-dc47b44c9579)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll worksheet architecture rewrite verified. Key changes: (1) loadWorksheet uses refs to avoid useCallback dependency chain, (2) hasShiftContent excludes notes, (3) legacy entries tracked via baselineLegacyRef for diff-based saves, (4) section-by-section error handling, (5) adjustment sign changes work, (6) end time can be added independently. All fixes working correctly.
